messages:
Maya (CS): Quick pulse from the ClarityHealth pilot — week 2 wrap. We captured 4 feature asks + 2 blockers that are directly affecting renewal conversation. Sharing notes and asking for triage.
Maya (CS): Raw list:
1) Long template responses sometimes get truncated — looks like a tokenizer/sequence issue. Workaround: shorten templates.
2) Finance can't get per-route cost visibility in console -> blocked on approval to move forward.
3) Transcript CSV export missing metadata (user ids, session tags). They need this for audit.
4) Reranker produces inconsistent order for non-English locales.
Maya (CS): Blockers: per-route billing visibility (blocks decision), and a customer-reported intermittent 5xx when exporting large transcripts (we captured logs).
Ethan (PM): Thanks Maya. Can you add impact and rough frequency for each item? That will help us prioritize before the sprint.
Maya (CS): Sure — estimates: 1 impact=high, freq~10% sessions; 2 impact=critical for renewals, freq~all finance reviews; 3 impact=medium, freq~5%; 4 impact=low-medium, freq~2%. 5xx export happens ~1% of large exports.
Noah (ProdEng): For #1, we actually have a tokenizer config change ready as a quick patch. Risky if we change defaults but should fix truncation. Posting diff: 
```diff
- token_config: default
+ token_config: trim_longer_templates: true
```
jenna (CS): FYI the finance lead literally paused the enablement call yesterday because they couldn't reconcile per-route cost. This is increasing renewal risk :grimacing:
Ethan (PM): Ok — console per-route visibility = P0. Tokenizer patch = P1. Transcript metadata = P2. Reranker language evaluation = P3. Who can own tickets?
Maya (CS): I can own console work + transcript export (A and C). I'll gather the exact customer quote snippets to attach.
Noah (ProdEng): I'll take the tokenizer change (B) and spike any regression tests. CSV export spike sounds straightforward; can help if needed.
Ethan (PM): I'll own the reranker evaluation and coordinate multilingual test prompts.
feedback-bot: Created issues RW-4591 (console-billing-exports), RW-4592 (tokenizer-truncation-patch), RW-4593 (transcript-export-metadata), RW-4594 (reranker-lang-eval) and linked them to workspace "ClarityHealth-pilot".
Maya (CS): Please add customer quotes to RW-4591 and tag sales/AM. That context matters for prioritization during the executive review.
Ethan (PM): Done — added quotes and tagged @AM_Clarity. Also added the P0/P1/P2/P3 labels.
jenna (CS): Short-term ask: can we add a console CSV export toggle for per-route billing as an interim? Even a manual CSV would unblock finance.
Noah (ProdEng): CSV export toggle is low-effort — I'll spike it today, ETA EOD. If it works we can ship as a temporary mitigation.
Maya (CS): Great — I'll update the renewal-risk tracker and ping AM. Also scheduling a quick sync with Clarity finance tomorrow 11am PT.
Ethan (PM): Let's review progress in our daily sync tomorrow 10am PT and decide which items go into next sprint. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
